name: Burg Hohenzollern
_about: BURG HOHENZOLLERN (1850-67, Friedrich August Stüler for King Friedrich Wilhelm IV; the fortifications by Moritz von Prittwitz) on the summit of the Hohenzollern, after OpenStreetMap's plan: the bastion ring; the serpentine approach through the Adlertor (twice), round the Wilhelmsturm and the lower Zwinger, and the Rampenturm's spiral; the Torturm; the four ranges round the inner court with the Kaiser-, Bischofs-, Markgrafen-, Michaels- and Wartturm; the Christuskapelle and St Michael's chapel. Walkable: the courtyards and the ramp, the principal floor's Stammbaumhalle, Grafensaal (rib vaults on columns), library, the royal rooms, the chapels, the upper floor; the state stair and the Wartturm's spiral between the floors. Generated by tools/archgen/hohenzollern.py.
